title: Digital Content Director & Video Editor (Part-Time with Full-Time Scale Potential)
description:
*** PAYMENT SCHEDULE: This position is paid Bi-Monthly (twice per month) on a fixed, predictable corporate schedule. ***

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The VEXXIA Lifestyle Entity is seeking a high-agency, long-term Digital Content Director & Video Editor to manage our multi-channel video pipeline. 



You will be handed a massive 5-year vault of premium, raw international and domestic travel footage, alongside fresh weekly lifestyle and business product recordings. Your single core focus is to turn raw assets into a high-retention storytelling machine. 





NOTE: Because this role involves handling highly confidential personal footage, behind-the-scenes assets from major network TV productions, and proprietary business materials, a signed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) is a mandatory condition of employment.





CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. The YouTube Long-Form Show: Produce ONE premium, high-retention long-form episode per week from raw, unorganized, and unnamed footage dumps. You must be comfortable scrubbing raw files to piece together a dynamic narrative.



2. The Social Media Splitting: Extract and edit a MINIMUM of three high-velocity vertical short-form clips per week from the master episode to syndicate across shorts feeds.



3. The Product Engine: Edit THREE short vertical product-showcase clips per week for our 3D printing e-commerce division (raw footage of finished items provided, no long-form editing required).



4. Full Digital Distribution & SEO: Manage our Metricool dashboard to schedule and cross-post all assets. You are entirely responsible for top-tier SEO (titles, detailed metadata, tags, deep descriptions), writing captions, designing cover stills, and creating THREE variations of high-click-through thumbnails per long-form video for split testing.







REQUIRED CREATIVE EDITING STYLE:

We execute "High-Retention Cinematic Editing." You must study channels like HopeScope, Ryan Trahan, and Hangtime to fit our aesthetic workflow.

* The Pacing: Hyper-fast, changing visual scales, camera moves, or B-roll inserts every 3-5 seconds. However, you must leave tiny micro-pauses of breathing room for natural voice humor and dry delivery to shine. No robotic over-chopping.

* The Graphics & Text Style (High-Attention Revenue Engine): On-screen text, callouts, and info-graphics must be highly dynamic, energetic, and fully animated (pops, slides, and motion-tracking) to maximize viewer retention. We want a polished, high-end production look that feels expensive and drives massive engagement. You have total creative freedom to use high-contrast text, stylized graphics, neon highlights, and attention-grabbing pop-ups to punch up the comedic timing, highlight the story pacing, and keep eyes locked on the screen.

* The Hook & Frame: Every long-form video must open with 5-10 seconds of intense, high-stakes manufactured opening drama (the curiosity hook) before hitting a clean, gamified chapter structure using leaderboard tallies and progressive step counters on screen.



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

If you are an independent problem solver who thrives under low micromanagement and can turn unorganized folders into master-level media properties, we want you. 



To apply, please reply with a link to your current video portfolio or sample sheet. IMPORTANT: To prove your attention to detail, you must start your response to this listing with the words "SIDE QUEST" in all capital letters. Applications without this keyword will be automatically deleted. 



We look forward to building this empire with you!

title: COO/Management Residential Appraisal Report Writer
description:
We are a successful residential appraisal firm located in the Bay Area, California. We employ over 10 on the team and are looking for a very senior level experienced residential appraisal report writer to lead our team.



The team includes 3 Bay Area appraisers and 8 employees in the Philippines. We are rapidly growing and are looking for someone with experience completing the entire residential appraisal report, including commentary, who ideally has experience with managing and leading other appraisal report writers. Your role will effectively be acting as chief operating officer of our company while also being directly involved in reports.



Your role and responsibilities include the following:

1. Ensuring every report is completed to our standards. Either directly or through the processes and procedures you develop, it will be your responsibility to ensure that each and every report created by our report writers is free from errors and submission-ready. While this will start by having you directly review each report written by our team before submission, we are in the process of also hiring quality assurance reviewers, who you will lead and manage.

2. Training and managing residential report writers. It will be your responsibility to ensure that all report writers on our tea
et the criteria and standards in place to ensure high quality reports.

3. Acting as the liaison between leadership and the report writing staff. If there is too much work for the team, you will be in charge of letting leadership know so that additional tea
mbers can be hired. Or if there are any other issues, you will be in charge of resolving them or bringing it to leadership's attention.

4. Acting as the closer. Ultimately, everything on the report writing side will fall under your responsibility. We are looking for someone who is proactive at solving problems without getting the leadership team involved, however we are of course readily available to help out when needed. In line with this, if the report writing team doesn't have capacity to complete a residential report, you are expected to directly help out and complete these reports while at the same time working towards a solution to address this issue (hiring more, building better processes for writing reports, involving AI, etc).



To be considered for this role, you must meet the following criteria:

1. You have extensive work history writing reports for a US residential appraiser. Ideally you have done this for California properties. You must have extensive experience completing the entire report, everything from data entry to sketch to adjustments, 1004MC, selecting comparables, and commentary. If you do not have this experience, we will be unable to consider you for this position.

2. Ideally you have existing management experience, managing other appraisal report writers.



We are flexible with your work hours and offer Philippine daytime shift hours for your convenience. We would like to start part time but then transition to full time, so ideally you are open to working full time exclusively with us if its a mutual fit.



To be considered for this position, you must do the following in your application message (failure to do all of the following will result in your application being ignored):

1. How many years have you worked for a US residential appraiser? What tasks did you perform for them?

2. How many hours does it take you to complete one report? What parts of the report do you complete?

3. Do you have experience writing commentary for the addendum, drawing the sketch, labeling photos, and creating the 1004MC? Please indicate which ones you have experience with, and how many years for each.

4. Please provide a sample of at least one appraisal report you have fully completed. You can redact any private information from the report. Please let me know what parts exactly you completed on this report(s).

5. Provide a publicly accessible link to your resume.

6. Are you open to starting part time and then transitioning to full time? Once working full time with us, will you be working exclusively with us without any other jobs? When is the earliest you can begin working with us?

7. What are your preferred working hours?

8. Do you have experience managing other residential appraisal report writers? If so, please discuss in detail your job responsibilities.

9. Do you have experience in reviewing other residential reports? If so, please discuss in detail your responsibilities.



Thank you, and I look forward to the opportunity to work together.

title: YouTube Story Editor & Content Support Specialist
description:
YouTube Story Editor & Content Support Specialist      5 to 10 hours per week to start



The Expat Playbook



ABOUT THE EXPAT PLAYBOOK



The Expat Playbook is not a travel channel.



It is a storytelling channel about reinvention, freedom, realization, and building a meaningful life after 50.



Our audience includes retirees, veterans, solo travelers, expats, and people who feel stuck and are looking for a different path forward.



While living abroad is often part of the story, our deeper focus is on transformation.



We create content about:



• Reinvention after 50

• Living abroad

• Personal freedom

• Retirement overseas

• Veteran perspective

• Starting over

• Adventure and curiosity

• Purpose and fulfillment

• Building a life without regret



Our videos combine voice-over storytelling, travel footage, daily life abroad, cinematic visuals, documentary-style editing, and thoughtful sound design.



We are building a long-term brand and are looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for a story-driven editor who views editing as a craft.



The ideal candidate is a lifelong student of editing and storytelling. They actively study great editors, take courses, analyze films and YouTube content, and continuously improve their skills.



This is not simply a video editing job.



It is a storytelling role.



We are looking for someone who understands:



• Narrative structure

• Pacing

• Emotional storytelling

• Viewer psychology

• Visual storytelling

• Sound design

• Documentary editing

• YouTube audience retention



Maturity, professionalism, curiosity, and strong communication skills are highly valued.



If you love editing, love learning, and believe every cut should serve a purpose, we would love to hear from you.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Video Editing



• Edit long-form YouTube videos

• Edit YouTube Shorts

• Create rough cuts and review versions

• Organize footage and project files

• Maintain a consistent channel style



Storytelling



• Match visuals to narration

• Help shape emotional moments

• Improve pacing and viewer engagement

• Edit for clarity and comprehension

• Support the overall story, not just the visuals



Captions & Graphics



• Create captions when needed

• Add quote overlays

• Add chapter titles and lower thirds

• Create simple graphics that support the story



Audio & Sound Design



• Clean up voice-over audio

• Balance narration, music, and ambient sounds

• Add subtle sound design when appropriate

• Enhance immersion without distracting from the story



Content Support



• Source stock footage when needed

• Source royalty-free music

• Assist with AI-generated visuals when appropriate

• Help organize channel assets and project files



REQUIRED SKILLS



• Strong English comprehension

• Experience with YouTube editing

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to follow creative direction

• Good communication

• Reliable internet connection



Software proficiency in one or more of the following:



• Adobe Premiere Pro

• DaVinci Resolve

• Final Cut Pro

• CapCut



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Documentary editing experience

• Travel or lifestyle channel experience

• Experience with sound design

• Experience with color correction

• Experience sourcing stock footage

• Familiarity with AI tools and modern editing workflows

• Interest in storytelling, psychology, filmmaking, or personal development



Bonus Skills



• Photoshop

• Canva

• AI image generation

• AI video generation

• Motion graphics

• Thumbnail design

• YouTube Studio

• Storyboarding and content research



OUR EDITING PHILOSOPHY



Every edit serves the story.



Story comes before effects.



Meaning comes before trends.



We are not trying to create flashy videos.



We are trying to create videos that help viewers think, reflect, learn, and take action.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR



• TikTok-style editing

• Meme editing

• Gaming-style editing

• Excessive transitions

• Constant zoom effects

• Random sound effects

• MrBeast-style editing



Our audience is mature and thoughtful.



We value clarity, emotion, and storytelling.



PAID TEST EDIT



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid test edit.



The test may include:



• Voice-over narration

• Raw footage

• Stock footage

• AI-generated visuals

• Basic editing instructions



Applicants will be evaluated on:



• Storytelling ability

• Visual matching

• Pacing

• Sound design

• Attention to detail

• Communication



COMPENSATION

• Weekly availability

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

A brief introduction

Your editing experience

Three examples of your work

Software you use

What is the difference between editing a story and simply editing a video?



To help us identify applicants who pay attention to detail, please include the phrase:



"Story first."



somewhere in your application.

LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for a long-term creative partner who wants to grow with the channel and help build meaningful content that inspires people to rethink what's possible in the second half of life.

title: AI Image Generation VA
description:
AI Image Generation VA, Short-Form Video Content



I run a short-form video content operation producing AI-generated videos for health and beauty brands on Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube. I am hiring one person only (for now).



What you will do:

Take a script I provide and generate a full image batch, one image per line of the script. Each image must match the shot description, character, and setting. These images become the visual foundation for 1 to 2 minute AI videos.

- Character looks consistent across every image in the batch

- Background is specific and culturally authentic to the persona

- Shot angles, lighting, and props match the script context



Tools used: Claude and VEO3 or similar AI image generation tools.



Workflow:

I send you a script, you generate the image batch, you submit for review, I give Loom feedback, you revise until approved, batch goes to editors.

3 weeks at $150 flat. If you hit the standard consistently, the role continues at $250 per month.



To apply:

1. Start your message with the word VISUAL in all caps

2. Answer in 3 sentences or less: how would you keep a character consistent across multiple images in one batch?

3. Include your portfolio of AI-generated images



No portfolio, no consideration. No exceptions.

title: Social Media Manager / Booking Agent for Online Music Project
description:
I’m looking for a remote VA to help build and manage an exciting new online Substack-based original music production project. The project is in the early stages so offers great opportunities for additional responsibilities and wage increases for top performance as we grow. 



You will collaborate with me to strategize and implement a weekly content calendar of music recording instructional videos, Substack lives, monthly concert livestreams, podcast interviews, and music-related articles and tutorials to drive three main revenue streams: 



• Substack paid subscriptions

• Virtual concert gigs at colleges, conferences, festivals, art house theaters and other global venues 

• Sponsorships/affiliate advertising from relevant partners



The ideal candidate will be excited about collaborating with me to strategize, coordinate, and leverage my large catalogue of original rock music and virtual multimedia concert-presentations into active marketing funnels supporting these and future revenue streams. 



==================================================

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

==================================================



• Content Calendar Management: Help me strategize, produce, and upload/distribute project assets.

• Re-purposing digital assets across relevant online platforms to drive brand awareness and bring people into my Substack ecosystem. 

• Lead Generation for Booking Virtual Gigs: Online research and cold
ing to find and nurture contacts at venues (colleges, conferences, festivals, community theaters, independent art house film centers, etc.) across the world suitable for my unique brand of virtual concert presentations. (I will provide training to teach you what these virtual concerts are, to aid you in your outreach.)

• Lead Generation to book me on podcasts for interviews/performances and find promising Substack creators for potential collaborations and crossposts.

• Research of and outreach to potential partners for sponsorships and affiliate relationships. 

• Ongoing strategy sessions: Help me track and assess current business operations and brainstorm modifications to maximize and expand revenue opportunities.



==================================================

CORE TRAITS I’M LOOKING FOR: 

==================================================



• Creativity, initiative, and strategic thinking

• Promptness, honesty, reliability

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Strong collaborative spirit to work closely with me building a new innovative online venture

• Love of music / creative arts a plus



==================================================

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS:

==================================================



• Familiarity with Substack a plus, but if not, an eagerness to dive deep into mastering that platform as that is where the majority of my content will live 

• Proficiency with other social media platforms and ability to assess platform viability for re-purposed content and to upload and manage content on those platforms

• Communicative: You’re not afraid to give ideas, voice opinions and feedback, and to ask the right questions when anything is unclear

• Willingness to occasionally be on camera as a vital project collaborator during livestreams and other possible recorded videos is a definite plus

• Reliable internet connection



==================================================

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING DAILY:

==================================================



Each day you will work on one or more of the responsibilities listed above in the service of building my Substack audience, researching and nurturing virtual gig contacts and opportunities, and researching and setting up podcast interviews and collaborations/partnerships. 



Most days Monday to Friday we’ll do a check-in over Zoom for roughly 30 - 60 minutes in which you’ll update me on progress and we’ll brainstorm and discuss your tasks for that day. These Zoom sessions will likely be longer in the beginning as I train you on my music, history, story, etc., and shorter down the road as you become more familiar with me and the project and are able to take full initiative. 



==================================================

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU: 

==================================================



• Get in at the ground level of a unique and innovative online original music venture

• A chance to help shape the direction of a creative project from the ground up with a large impact on its direction and evolution

• Long-term, stable remote work with the potential to expand scope and rate



==================================================

HOURS & COMPENSATION:

==================================================



• 4 hours a day, Monday - Friday (flexible, remote)

• $5/hour   



==================================================

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

==================================================

2. Send a brief summary of your experience as a VA. Include type of client, industry, type of work done, and softwares used. If you don't have experience as a VA, please say so.

4. Describe your other current work commitments and preferred number of hours you have to dedicate to this job. 

5. Tell me your favorite rock artist. If you’re not into rock music, that’s fine; tell me your favorite music genre and favorite artist in that genre.



Rock on... because music matters.

title: Ecom Video Editor For Meta & TikTok Ads
description:
About Us:

We are a dynamic and rapidly growing 7-figure women's jewelry brand powered by Shopify. We are passionate about great design that speaks for itself, drawing inspiration from everyday fashion and influencers, and genuinely caring about the products we create and the relationships we build. Our marketing is performance-driven, and high-converting video creative is central to our scaling strategy.



The Role:

We're seeking a skilled and agile E-commerce Response Video Editor (full time / 40 hours per week) who understands how to create video ads that don't just look good but convert. You will work in lockstep with our Creative Strategist, taking raw footage (UGC, potentially studio shots) and briefs to produce engaging, platform-optimized video ads primarily for Meta 
/Instagram) and TikTok. Your job is to execute rapidly, iterate effectively based on performance insights (provided by the strategist), and ensure the final output is engineered for maximum engagement and conversions. Forget long-form content; this is about short, punchy, direct-response video.



IMPORTANT: 

This is not a role for someone juggling multiple jobs, working for or running a freelancing agency, or managing several clients at once. We are looking for a dedicated full-time video editor who will ONLY WORK EXCLUSIVELY WITH US and be fully committed to our brand, team, and creative output.



Key Responsibilities:



• Edit High-Performing Video Ads: Transform raw footage and strategist briefs into compelling video ads optimized for Meta and TikTok feeds/stories/reels.



• Rapid Iteration: Quickly execute multiple variations of winning ad concepts provided by the Creative Strategist (testing different hooks, visuals, text overlays, CTAs, music). Understand that iteration based on data is key.



• Platform Optimization: Expertly edit for platform best practices – strong hooks within the first 3 seconds, fast pacing, engaging captions/text overlays, appropriate aspect ratios (9:16, 1:1, 4:5), safe zones, and effective sound design.



• Integrate Copy & CTAs: Seamlessly weave in primary text concepts, headlines, and clear calls-to-action as guided by the strategist.



• Collaborate Closely: Maintain clear, fast communication (Slack, etc.) with the Creative Strategist to receive feedback, discuss edits, and ensure alignment with performance goals.



• Asset Management: Organize and manage video files and project assets efficiently.



• Meet Deadlines: Deliver high-quality edits reliably and on schedule in a fast-paced environment.



Who We're Looking For:



• Proven Social Ad Editing Experience: Minimum 2+ experience specifically editing short-form video advertisements for performance marketing campaigns on Meta & TikTok. A portfolio showcasing direct-response style video ads is required.



• Technical Proficiency: Highly skilled in video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut is a major plus). Proficiency in basic motion graphics (e.g., After Effects for text overlays) is desirable.



• Platform Native: Deep understanding of what works visually on TikTok and Meta feeds/stories/reels – you know the trends, the hooks, the pacing, the sounds that grab attention immediately.



• Performance-Oriented Mindset: You understand the goal is conversion, not just aesthetics. You are receptive to feedback driven by ad metrics and can adapt edits accordingly. (Links to Strategist's "Data Mastery," "Creativity That Converts").



• Speed and Agility: Ability to work quickly, execute variations efficiently, and adapt to changing requirements without sacrificing quality. (Links to Strategist's "Adaptability & Agility").



• Collaborative Spirit: Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively and receive direction from a Creative Strategist. (Links to Strategist's "Collaboration is Key," "Clear Communication").



• Strong Work Ethic & Accountability: Reliable, proactive, meets deadlines, and takes ownership of edit quality – no babysitting needed. (Links to Strategist's "Work Ethic").



• Detail-Oriented: Ensures brand consistency, correct aspect ratios, and error-free text/graphics. Nothing sloppy makes the cut.



• Basic understanding of direct response marketing principles.



• Experience editing UGC content.



Compensation:

$2,000 monthly base salary, with the opportunity to earn monthly performance-based bonuses tied to creative contributions. Total monthly compensation can reach up to $4,000 based on performance.



***** HOW TO APPLY *****



In your proposal, you MUST include (give as much detail as possible):



1. Provide your Resume/CV and link to your portfolio showcasing E-CO
RCE VIDEO ADS for Meta/TikTok. Other type of ads will not be looked at or considered. 

2. Briefly describe your process for editing a typical 15-45 sec. video ad.

3. How do you handle feedback and rapid iteration requests from creative strategists?

4. List your primary editing software and mention your experience with CapCut.

5. What AI tools or software have you used to create video ads and which is your favorite? Provide as much detail as possible and share any previous AI work if any.



***** APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS *****



1. Applicants MUST use a minimum of 10 Apply Points for their application to be looked at and considered.

2. Applicants MUST be willing to complete a practical editing exercise/test trial as part of the hiring process. This is not a paid trial but for the right candidate, this opportunity can lead directly to a long-term position with us.

By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalized and affordable. And we’re just getting started.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Travel, Procurement & Fleet Coordinator to manage operations for our Australian business. This multi-faceted role is critical to maintaining seamless daily logistics. You will be responsible for orchestrating domestic and corporate travel, managing supplier procurement in line with local compliance, and assisting with the maintenance and safety of our corporate fleet.

The ideal candidate understands the Australian vendor landscape, has experience managing corporate travel across ANZ, and brings a strong customer-service focus to supporting our local workforce.



Key Responsibilities

1. Travel Management (Approx. 40%)

Booking & Domestic Logistics: Coordinate extensive corporate travel bookings across Australia (interstate) including flights (Qantas, Virgin Australia, Jetstar), corporate accommodation, and car rentals.

Policy Compliance: Enforce the company’s travel and expense policy, ensuring cost-efficient booking habits and appropriate tier selections.

Local Sourcing: Raise purchase requisitions and manage the end-to-end purchase order (PO) process for Australian suppliers, covering office supplies, IT equipment, and operational materials.



Vendor Management: Onboard new vendors, track supplier performance, and maintain compliant records including valid Australian Business Numbers (ABNs) and GST status verification.



Payment Lifecycle Collaboration: Reconcile invoices against delivery receipts and POs, liaising closely with the Accounts Payable team to ensure adherence to agreed payment terms.



Modern Slavery Act Compliance: Assist the procurement team in verifying supplier compliance in alignment with corporate social responsibility guidelines and local Modern Slavery reporting frameworks.



3. Fleet Management Assistance (Approx. 20%)

Asset Tracking & Registration: Maintain an updated corporate fleet registry, ensuring all vehicle registrations (via relevant state bodies like VicRoads, Transport for NSW, TMR, etc.) and compulsory third-party (CTP) insurances are systematically renewed.



Maintenance & Safety: Coordinate scheduled logbook servicing, tyre replacements, and vehicle inspections to maintain fleet safety and uphold manufacturer warranties.



Fuel Cards & Linkt/E-Toll Management: Monitor corporate fuel card accounts (e.g., Ampol, BP, Shell) and toll account usage (e.g., Linkt), reporting on weekly or monthly variances.

 Management: Assist drivers with a

Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an operations, procurement, or corporate travel coordination role within Australia. Previous exposure to vehicle fleet coordination or logistics is highly regarded.



Technical Systems: Proficiency with ERP/financial software (e.g., Xero, MYOB, SAP, NetSuite), expense management tools, and corporate travel software (e.g., Velocity, Concur).

title: Real Estate Media Photo Video Assistant
description:
Summary

Part-time or full-time virtual assistant with experience sending photos to clients, editing/fixing photos and videos of houses for real estate.



What a typical day may look like:

1) Submit photos to AutoHDR from Dropbox (our photographers upload at the end of the day Toronto time.

2) Make sure the photos look good and make any necessary adjustments to fix the photos either in Lightroom or within AutoHDR.

3) upload photos to Aryeo (platform to send media to real estate agents) and send to clients.

4) review videos from our editing team in Vietnam, provide feedback and revision to our Vietnam team if there are any glitches or fixes needing to be made.

5) upload final video to Aryeo to send to our clients (same listing portal as photos)

6) the above should take up most of the day, if there is extra time (especially in slower seasons), assist with our marketing and social media and other administrative tasks.



About the Company

We are a growing real estate media company based in Canada. We provide high-quality photography, videography, and marketing content for real estate agents. We need a reliable Media Editor & QC Virtual Assistant who can work while we sleep so listings are ready for our North American clients in the morning.



Photos Quality Assurance

We use AutoHDR for our photo editing. Sometimes the program makes mistakes and we need someone with a good eye and attention to detail to make those fixes before sending to the client.



Video Quality Assurance

We have a separate video editing vendor in Vietnam, you would review the videos and provide any feedback and fixes to our video editing team or be able to make simple fixes yourself.



Job Responsibilities

- Edit and enhance real estate photos (straightening slanted/horizontal lines, exposure, white balance, composition improvements, lens correction, etc.).

- Perform quality control on photos and ensure professional standards for composition, lighting, and overall appeal.

- Use AutoHDR and/or Lightroom for photo editing and fixes.

- Review video tours edited by our team in Vietnam using Final Cut Pro. Make minor fixes (color, cuts, stabilization, etc.) or provide clear revision notes to the editor if major changes are needed.

- Deliver completed media packages through Aryeo to clients.

- Maintain consistent brand standards and meet tight deadlines.



Requirements

- Proven experience editing real estate photos with a strong eye for composition, lighting, and fixing slanted/horizontal images.

- Experience delivering media through Aryeo.

- Comfortable using (or quick to learn) AutoHDR for photo enhancement.

- Proficient in Final Cut Pro for basic video fixes and QC.

- Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken).

- High-speed, stable internet connection with reliable power backup (no frequent outages) — this is critical as tasks are urgent and time-sensitive.

- Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently.



Big advantage if you have:

• Previous experience working with North American or Canadian real estate media companies.

• Fast turnaround and strong attention to detail under deadline pressure.



What We Offer:

• Competitive hourly rate with long-term opportunity with a growing company.

• Clear training, SOPs, and Loom videos for our exact workflow.



Your resume/CV:

- experience related to this position

- Short video introduction (1–2 minutes) covering:

- Your experience with Aryeo, AutoHDR, Lightroom, and Final Cut Pro.

- Why you’re a good fit for real estate media delivery, quality assurance and editing.



Working during your day while it is our night time:

Your availability working during the day in your time zone. Our timezone is Toronto
 Time and it would be preferred that while it is our night that you are working with our video editing vendor in Vietnam and preparing photos to send to clients during the day in Philippine or similar time zone.

• Client dashboards

• Client success

Dashboard Support

• Assist with ongoing dashboard quality control



Process Improvement



• Follow documented SOPs

• Help improve existing processes

• Identify opportunities for automation

• Help create scalable systems as we grow



WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT INCLUDE



You will NOT be responsible for:



• Tax preparation

• Tax strategy

• Payroll processing

• Sales tax filings

• IRS communication

• Legal advice

• CPA-level advisory work



Our focus is financial visibility, reporting accuracy, and operational decision-making.



REQUIREMENTS



Must Have



• 4+ years of recent QuickBooks Online experience

• Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals

• Experience reconciling multiple accounts

• Experience managing books for multiple businesses or clients

• Strong attention to detail

• Excellent organizational skills

After 90 Days

• Dashboard numbers match QuickBooks

• Financial reporting is reliable and consistent

• Issues are proactively identified before becoming problems



After 12 Months



• You are the trusted owner of financial reporting inside PestLaunch

• Client financial data is clean, current, and standardized

• Dashboard accuracy exceeds 95%

• Financial reporting systems are scalable across dozens of clients

• PestLaunch leadership trusts the numbers without needing to verify them



COMPENSATION

mbers and client reporting systems.

• Visit competitor stores to document pricing, upsells, bundle offers, and guarantee language

• Go through competitor funnels end-to-end and document the full flow with screenshots

• Identify gaps in competitor positioning that we can exploit with our own angle

• Note shipping times, product reviews, and customer complaints to find improvement opportunities



Ad download and dashboard entry

• Download winning competitor video and image ads and save them in the shared drive, organised by product

• Log every winning ad into the research dashboard: product name, ad link, ad spend estimate, hook, angle, target market, and your commentary

• Tag each entry clearly so the Operations Manager and Media Buyer can filter and use it instantly

• Keep the dashboard clean and up to date — no orphaned entries, no missing fields



Product reporting

• Submit 3–5 researched product opportunities per week in our standard product report format

• Each report must include: product overview, winning ads found, competitor store links, suggested angle, estimated market demand, and a recommendation on whether to test

• Flag products that are already oversaturated so we do not waste budget testing them

• Present your top pick each week in a short async video or voice note walking through your reasoning





Who you are

• You have at least 1 year of experience in eCommerce product research, dropshipping, or a similar role

• You know how to use
 Ad Library and at least one paid spy tool (Minea, Adspy, PiPiAds, or similar)

• You understand what makes an ad “winning” — not just high likes, but actual spend and run time signals

• You are highly organised and consistent — you follow the same process every day without being reminded

• You can write clear, structured notes in English — your reports need to be usable by the team without a follow-up call

• You are proactive — you flag opportunities and problems before being asked

• You understand the EU beauty, health, or wellness market (or are willing to learn it quickly)





Nice to have

• Experience working in a dropshipping business or for an eCommerce brand

• Familiarity with Funnelish, ClickFunnels, or Shopify from a research perspective

• EU language skills — French, German, Dutch, Spanish, or Italian

• Understanding of
 ad metrics: CPM, CTR, ROAS, frequency

• Experience estimating competitor ad spend from tool data





How we work

We are a small, fully remote team. We communicate async-first via Slack or Notion. You will have a daily check-in with the Operations Manager and a weekly product review call. We use structured templates for everything — your job is to fill them accurately and consistently, not to reinvent the process.

We move fast. When a winning product is identified, it goes into testing within days. Your research directly feeds the business, so quality and speed both matter.

title: Creative Strategist - Beauty Brand
description:
Creative Strategist — Facelove Cosmetics



Facelove is a pro-age beauty brand built for the mature woman. We've scaled from zero to a serious revenue engine off the back of performance marketing, and we're now growing hard into the US. The constraint on that growth isn't budget, it's a steady supply of genuinely winning concepts. That's the job.



The role: 

You own creative strategy: concepts, angles, hooks, briefs. Your job is not to decorate a framework, it's to invent concepts that sell to a very specific, very skeptical woman, roughly 50–65, who's been burned by this industry before and silently asks "is this just hype?" before she buys anything. You'll build fully structured briefs and hand concepts to our creative team who turn them into the ads that carry our spend.





What you'll own: 



- Original concepts — the single biggest driver of performance here. New ideas out of your own head, not recycled formulas or competitor copies.

- Angles, hooks, and the mechanism — built from real voice-of-customer language, not generic beauty-speak.

- A constant pipeline of original, performing concepts. At our scale, that volume is what unlocks more spend.



Who we're looking for: 

The bar here is high and explicit: original concept creation, not recycled formulas. The old "problem ? bridge ? solution ? social proof ? CTA" template of creative strategy that worked 2 years ago, doesn't perform anymore, the concept and the format are what carry the ad, every time. The framework alone is never enough. 



The person who clears that bar is:



- DR-native. You study the craft and can point to specific direct-response ads and explain why each works — the hook, the angle, the mechanism.

- A proven performer. You can name real ads you've shipped, the number each moved, and the baseline it beat — and you're honest about what was yours versus the team's or the budget's.

- Obsessive and founder-minded. You go past your lane because you can't help yourself.

- A business thinker. You ship tests fast, scale what's validated, cut what isn't.

- Fast, specific, and allergic to fluff. Our voice is blunt and so is our team.



How to apply: 

Answer the five questions below. Bullets are perfect, we're reading your thinking, not grading your writing. Keep it real and specific: we go deep on everything you write in a live conversation, so don't run it through AI. We'll know. NOTE: This is just the minimum that we're asking, feel free to go beyond it by sharing more about yourself, your drive and what you'll bring to the table. 



1. Your top 3 ads. Link or screenshot each. In bullets: what number it moved, the baseline it beat, over what period and how you know that result was yours, not the team's or the budget's or luck.



2. The brands that inspire your DR marketing. List at least 5. From those brands, point to the specific ads you rate as the best direct response — and add a line on why each one works.



3. Your first 90 days at Facelove. What impact would you make in month one, month two, and month three? 



4. Something about a past brand that wasn't your job to know or work on. What did you dig into, learn, or take on that wasn't in your remit — and how did you come to it?



5. Spend 5 minutes on 
 and our ads in the Meta Ad Library. What would you change in our ads to drive more growth? Max 2 sentences.

* Design and build new custom modules

* Modify and extend existing Odoo functionality

* Maintain and improve custom workflows

* Debug and resolve production issues quickly

* Optimize performance and database operations

* Build custom reports and dashboards

* Create integrations with third-party systems and APIs

* Assist with Odoo upgrades and migrations

* Improve user experience and operational efficiency

* Provide ongoing support and strategic recommendations

* Purchasing

* Warehouse Operations

* Manufacturing Processes

* Vendor Management

* Customer Service

* Logistics & Freight Operations

* Reporting & Analytics

* Accounting Integrations

* CRM and Sales Operations



We have numerous custom modules, automated workflows, and business-specific processes that require both maintenance and ongoing enhancement.



## Required Experience

* 5+ years of Odoo development experience

* Strong Python skills

* Experience with Odoo Studio and custom code

* Experience with API integrations

* Experience with Odoo version upgrades and migrations

* Logistics and transportation workflows

* EDI integrations

* Shipping carrier integrations

* Accounting and financial integrations

, BBB

Target 40 to 60 verified citations in the first 90 days

Audit NAP consistency across all platforms quarterly and correct any drift

title: Accounting Assistant
description:
One Janitorial — Remote, Full-time, Contract



How to Apply

Please read the full job description below before applying.

This role requires a written application AND a 3-minute video. If you only apply through the job board, your application will not be reviewed.



The full application takes about 15 minutes.

Step 1 — Complete the application form: 

Step 2 — Submit a 3-minute video answering ALL THREE questions. Upload to Google Drive (set to "anyone with the link"), Loom, or YouTube (unlisted), and paste the link into the application form.

Videos longer than 4 minutes will not be reviewed. Videos that don't answer all three questions will not be reviewed.

Question 1: Walk us through your experience in QuickBooks. What did you use it for day to day — payroll, reconciliation, AR, AP — and how comfortable are you across the full platform?

Question 2: Talk us through how you'd reconcile a month of transactions when the books don't balance. Where do you start, how do you find the discrepancy, and how do you make sure it doesn't happen again? We want to hear how you think through a problem.

Question 3: Walk me through the accounting role from your background that's most relevant to this one. Why does it line up? How long were you there, what did your day-to-day look like, what were you responsible for, and how did you perform against it?

Real examples only. No scripts read off a page.

Compensation & Logistics

Compensation: 50,000 to 66,000

Location: Fully remote. Reliable internet with a backup connection required for if your primary goes down.

Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Mountain Time (Edmonton, Alberta).

Reports to: Accounting Manager

About One Janitorial

One Janitorial is a commercial cleaning company operating across Canada with active US expansion. We manage roughly 700 clients and 180+ alliance partners through a 36-person fully remote team. We're scaling toward $11–12M in revenue in 2027.

We don't clean buildings ourselves. We sell commercial cleaning contracts to businesses — medical clinics, offices, retail, warehouses, restaurants — and match them to local cleaning alliances who do the work. Behind all of it is a finance function that has to be accurate, on time, and clean. That's where you come in.

We move fast and we run lean. Our books have to be right, our people have to be paid, and our receivables have to be collected — on time, every time.

RESPONSIBILITIES

•	Manage accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR) processes accurately and on time.

•	Perform bank, credit card, and account reconciliations to ensure financial records are accurate.

•	Process payroll and maintain payroll records in compliance with company policies.

•	Investigate and resolve discrepancies in financial transactions and account balances.

•	Maintain accurate bookkeeping records using QuickBooks.

•	Prepare and review financial reports, invoices, and supporting documentation.

•	Monitor outstanding receivables and assist with collections activities.

•	Ensure all accounting transactions are recorded correctly and according to established procedures.

•	Support month-end and year-end closing processes.

•	Collaborate with the Accounting Manager and other departments to improve financial processes and reporting accuracy.

•	Maintain organized financial records and documentation for audit and compliance purposes.

•	Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and prevent recurring accounting errors.

QUALIFICATIONS

•	Proven experience in bookkeeping, accounting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, or a related finance role.

•	Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks, including reconciliation, AP, AR, payroll, and reporting functions.

•	Experience performing bank and credit card reconciliations.

•	Understanding of basic accounting principles and financial reporting.

•	High attention to detail and strong accuracy when handling financial data.

•	Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

•	Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

•	Strong organizational and time-management skills.

•	Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.

•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

•	Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

•	Reliable internet connection with a backup connection available.

•	Experience supporting month-end close processes is an asset.

•	Experience in service-based businesses or multi-location operations is an advantage

Benefits:

•	Work from home

Application Question(s):

•	Which accounting functions have you regularly handled?

•	What is the largest number of transactions you have reconciled in a single month?

•	Please briefly describe your experience with QuickBooks, including reconciliation, AP, AR, and payroll.

Experience:

•	QuickBooks: 3 years (Required)

•	Accounting: 3 years (Required)

title: Senior Residential Appraisal Report Writer
description:
I run a residential appraisal firm located in the Bay Area, California, and am looking for an experienced residential appraisal writer to join the team. The team includes 3 Bay Area appraisers and 8 employees in the Philippines. We are rapidly growing and are looking for an experienced and senior level residential report writer to join our team.



Your role will be to do the following:

1. Complete the entire residential appraisal report after the appraiser has provided you with the inspection information and comparables. This includes all the commentary, adjustments, and all other parts of the report. We will provide training on how we specifically expect the commentary and adjustments based on our own personal preferences, however you are expected to already have this type of experience working for other appraisers.

2. Review the work of other report writers on our team, provide feedback, and help train newer report writers on our team. You are expected to act as the "last line of defense" of the report before it is sent to the appraiser for their final review before submission. As such, we expect you to be able to review the report, find any issues, correct these issues, and then send to the appraiser a near perfect report.



To be considered for this role, you must meet the following criteria:

1. You have worked for a US residential appraiser

2. You have experience performing data entry for residential properties in the US

3. You have experience creating the 1004MC, selecting comparables, drawing the sketch, labeling photos, making adjustments to the sales grid, and making commentary for the addendum.

4. Ideally, you have experience managing other appraisal report writers.



If you don't have experience in writing commentary or the addendum, or do not have experience with making adjustments on the sales grid, we would still like to hear from you as we have a different job that would fit your experience better.



We are flexible with your work hours and offer Philippine daytime shift hours for your convenience. We would like to start part time but then transition to full time, so ideally you are open to working full time exclusively with us if its a mutual fit.



To be considered for this position, you must do the following in your application message (failure to do all of the following will result in your application being ignored):

1. How many years have you worked for a US residential appraiser? What tasks did you perform for them?

2. How many hours does it take you to complete one report? What parts of the report do you complete?

3. Do you have experience writing commentary for the addendum, drawing the sketch, labeling photos, and creating the 1004MC? Please indicate which ones you have experience with, and how many years for each.

4. Please provide a sample of at least one appraisal report you have fully completed. You can redact any private information from the report. Please let me know what parts exactly you completed on this report(s).

5. Provide a publicly accessible link to your resume.

6. Are you open to starting part time and then transitioning to full time? Once working full time with us, will you be working exclusively with us without any other jobs? When is the earliest you can begin working with us?

7. What are your preferred working hours?

8. Do you have experience managing other residential appraisal report writers? If so, please discuss in detail your job responsibilities.



Thank you, and I look forward to the opportunity to work together.

title: Appointment Setter / Sales Setter
description:
Appointment Setter / Sales Setter

Product Manager Accelerator (PMA)

 Remote | Full-Time





Overview

Product Manager Accelerator (PMA) helps ambitious professionals break into product management, AI product management, and land opportunities at leading tech companies and startup unicorns. Founded by Dr. Nancy Li, a Forbes-featured product leader, PMA has helped professionals accelerate their careers through world-class coaching, training, and community.

We are one of the fastest-growing companies in the product management and AI career education space, and we are looking for a hungry, coachable, and high-energy Appointment Setter to join our sales team.

This role is ideal for someone who loves sales, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and wants to grow in the high-ticket coaching and education industry.

Our programs range from $6,000 to $20,000, so this is not an entry-level admin role. This is a high-performance sales role for someone serious about learning, earning, and growing.



About the Role

As an Appointment Setter, your main responsibility is to start conversations with qualified leads, build trust, follow up consistently, handle early objections, and book high-quality calls for our closers.

You will be speaking with both warm leads from YouTube and other organic channels, as well as cold leads generated through paid ads.

You will engage prospects through channels such as Instagram, LinkedIn,
, SMS, and phone, and help move them toward booking a qualified sales call with our team.

This is a high-intensity, high-reward role. People who are hungry, resilient, coachable, competitive, and fast learners tend to do very well here.



Key Responsibilities

Reach out to and follow up with both warm leads from YouTube and organic channels and cold leads from paid ads

Start conversations with prospective clients and qualify their interest, urgency, and fit

Book qualified sales calls for closers and help maintain a full calendar

Follow up consistently with leads who have shown interest but have not yet booked

Re-engage old leads and no-shows to generate more booked calls

Build rapport quickly and communicate clearly with prospects

Use scripts, sales processes, and setter frameworks provided by the company

Track outreach, follow-ups, booked calls, and outcomes accurately in the CRM or tracking sheet

Work closely with closers and sales leadership to improve show-up rates and conversion quality

Attend daily training, call reviews, and team meetings

Continuously improve through coaching, feedback, and performance reviews

Support the sales team with other related tasks as assigned



Who Will Do Well in This Role

This role is a strong fit for someone who is:

Hungry to make money and grow fast

Highly coachable and open to feedback

A fast learner who can improve quickly

Resilient and not discouraged by rejection or follow-up

Organized and consistent with lead follow-up

Competitive, proactive, and performance-driven

Comfortable working in a high-accountability environment

Interested in sales, persuasion, and the high-ticket coaching industry



Preferred Background

We strongly prefer candidates who have:

Previous experience as a setter, appointment setter, DM setter, inbound/outbound sales rep, or closer support

Experience in the education, coaching, consulting, or high-ticket offer industry

Experience selling or setting for offers in the $6,000 to $20,000 range, or similar high-ticket offers

Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken

Experience speaking with prospects through chat and phone

Candidates with direct setter or sales experience in the education or high-ticket coaching industry will be given strong preference.



Requirements

Very fluent in English

Excellent written communication and conversational selling skills

Confident speaking with leads on the phone and Zoom calls

Strong follow-up discipline and attention to detail

Able to work independently and hit performance goals remotely

Reliable internet connection and quiet work environment

Able to work full-time and fully commit to this role

Able to attend team training, daily call review, and coaching sessions

Willing to learn PMA’s sales process and improve quickly



Work Schedule

This is a full-time remote role.

Schedule may vary based on team needs, but candidates must be able to work during U.S. business hours. Minimum hours are 3pm EST - 10pm EST and 5 hours during the weekend.

This role is best suited for someone who can fully focus on PMA.

 If you currently have another full-time job, please do not apply.



Compensation

Base salary: $1,000 USD per month + performance-based commission

A good setter is expected to make more than $2,000-$4000 USD per month

Strong performers can earn significantly more based on results

This is a performance-driven role with real upside. For reference, our top closer/sales rep is earning $20,000 USD per month, and we are building a team of winners who want to grow into high-income sales professionals.



Benefits

Fully remote work

Performance-based compensation with strong upside

Company-provided sales and setter training

Daily call review and coaching

Ongoing mentorship and feedback from leadership

Opportunity to grow into a senior setter, closer, or sales leadership role

Work with a fast-growing education company changing people’s careers

Be part of a mission-driven company with a strong growth culture

Learn high-ticket sales in a real business with proven offers

Access to selected company training resources

Annual company-paid retreat — this year, we are going to South Africa



Company Culture

At PM Accelerator, we value:

Growth mindset

Coachability

Speed and execution

Ownership and accountability

Excellence and service

Making a real impact in people’s lives

We believe in helping our team members grow quickly, master their craft, and become leaders in their field.

PMA also donates a percentage of earnings to educational nonprofits that support entrepreneurship and mentorship for children from underserved communities.

Watch Dr. Nancy Li’s Forbes interview to learn more about the company and culture:

 



Why Join PMA

This is not just another remote job.

 This is an opportunity to learn high-ticket sales, work with a fast-growing brand, and build an income based on performance.

If you are hungry, driven, and serious about becoming excellent in sales, this role can open the door to long-term growth.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume through the job board where this position is posted.

 Do not
 your application directly, as it may get lost.

In your application, please answer:

Why do you want to work for PM Accelerator?

Why are you a strong fit for this setter role?

What experience do you have in setting, sales, or high-ticket coaching / education offers?

All shortlisted applicants may receive a take-home assignment and interview as part of the hiring process.

title: Customer Experience Lead $3,000-$4,000
description:
Customer Experience Lead



READ THIS FIRST — DO NOT APPLY UNLESS



You've LED customer support at a DTC subscription/rebill brand (supplements or health a big plus), not worked as one agent on a team

You've built a support function from scratch, or know exactly how: helpdesk, SOPs, team, the whole thing

You understand chargeback PREVENTION cold: keeping disputes from ever being filed, not winning them after

You've hit fast response standards (think sub-15-minute) through systems and coverage, not by personally living in the inbox

You've hired, trained, and managed support agents

Fast, responsive, available 6 days/week on EST hours



If that's not you, don't apply. If it is, keep reading.



The role



We're a DTC supplement brand on a subscription/rebill model, scaling aggressively. On track for 8 figures this year, targeting 9 across brands next year.

You'll own the entire customer experience function and build it from the ground up. Right now there's no helpdesk, no SOPs, no team. You build all of it. You're not a ticket-answerer. You're the leader who designs the system, hires the people, sets the standard, and owns the numbers, especially the one that matters most: chargebacks stay near zero.



What you'll own



The system



Set up and run the helpdesk (Gorgias): views, tags, routing, macros, automations, AI agent

Write the SOPs for every high-volume issue: refunds, cancellations, WISMO, rebill complaints, chargebacks

Build the KPI dashboard: first response time, resolution time, CSAT, refund rate, chargeback ratio



The team



Hire, train, and manage the support team

Build shift coverage that holds a 15-minute first response, 24/7, without you living in the inbox

Run QA, coaching, and accountability so quality holds as we scale



Subscription & retention



Own the rebill support experience: cancellations, save flows, failed payments, "why was I charged again"

Refund-first, proactive, customer-trust-protecting approach



Chargebacks (our #1 metric)



Keep the chargeback ratio under 0.5% through prevention: fast refunds, easy cancellation, clear billing descriptors, rebill reminders, pre-dispute alerts (Disputifier/Ethoca/Verifi), RDR, fraud screening at checkout

A filed chargeback is a loss even if we win it. Your job is they never get filed.



Scale



Build it so it clones. We're going from one brand to many; the system has to drop onto the next brand without starting over.





Requirements



Led CS/CX at a DTC subscription or rebill brand (supplements/health a plus)

Built a support function from scratch, or can prove you know how

Real chargeback prevention experience and knowledge of processor ratio thresholds

Hands-on helpdesk experience (Gorgias ideal, Zendesk/Reamaze fine)

Hired and managed agents

Extremely responsive, detail-obsessed, EST hours, 6 days/week





Why this role



You lead a department and build it your way, with real ownership from day one

Direct line to the founder, no bureaucracy

We're scaling to many brands. Build this well and you grow into running CX across all of them, with a real path to a senior/C-suite seat.





To apply, answer these (Yes/No or one line each)



Have you led a subscription/rebill brand's support? Which one, and what volume were they doing monthly?

Have you built an entire customer service team from scratch — if not, why do you think you would be capable of doing so?

How do you keep chargebacks from ever being filed and the ratio low? Name your tactics.

What chargeback ratios are you familiar with maintaining, and which chargeback alert tools have you used or know?

Have you held a 15-minute response time 24/7 using systems you built? How?

Can you work 6 days/week on EST hours?

We are seeking a world-class Senior Lead Generation Specialist & Outbound Technical Operator to serve as the strategic engine and audience growth hub of our firm. We specialize in placing high-performing Virtual Assistants and Executive Assistants with elite US-based clients.



This is a highly technical, data-driven execution role. You will own our entire outbound infrastructure, build advanced prospecting pipelines, maximize deliverability at scale, and manage our day-to-day growth systems. We will provide the core copywriting and messaging strategy, while you own the technical execution, spintax deployment, and continuous A/B testing to maximize performance.



If you are a master of
 deliverability, data engineering, and outbound systems, and you want to step into a high-visibility execution role with elite compensation, this is for you.



Your Core Responsibilities:

Infrastructure Architecture & Deliverability Mastery: Own the absolute health and scalability of our cold
 infrastructure (15+ domains, 50+ inboxes, and growing). Monitor deliverability daily, manage advanced inbox rotation/warmups, and proactively solve spam or sender reputation issues before they touch our data.

Data Operations & List Hygiene: Oversee advanced data scraping, list cleaning, and multi-step verification protocols to ensure optimal bounce rates and protect our sender reputation.

Campaign Execution & Rigorous Testing: Manage high-volume sending schedules and load pre-written sequences. You will take the copywriting we provide and run rigorous A/B testing on both copy variants and technical variables (sending windows, spintax, angles, and inbox distribution) to constantly optimize and maximize the positive reply rate.

Workflow Optimization: Build out smooth backend workflows, document advanced internal SOPs, and maintain the data pipelines that keep our outreach metrics flawless.

Pipeline Accountability: Own the primary metric of keeping our internal sales team fed with high-intent, warm "hand-raisers" who want to buy our services.



Requirements:

5+ Years of Elite B2B Outbound Experience: A proven track record of running sophisticated, high-volume B2B cold
 marketing and outbound data operations.

Advanced Tech Stack Mastery: Deep, practical expertise with modern outbound tools (e.g., Smartlead, Instantly, Clay, Apollo, DeBounce, MillionVerifier, list-enrichment APIs).

Technical Deliverability Expertise: Expert-level knowledge of DNS management, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and Custom Tracking Domains. You know how to play the cat-and-mouse game with ISPs to stay out of the promo/spam folders.

The "Data Scientist" DNA: You live in clean spreadsheets. You make decisions based on numbers, conversion percentages, and A/B test results, not gut feelings.

Exclusivity (No Moonlighting): This is a high-level, full-time position. Juggling other clients, freelancing, or agency side-gigs is strictly prohibited. We want 100% of your focus, and we compensate accordingly.



Shift & Location:

Schedule: Flexible working hours, but requires a structured daily overlap with US Business Hours (EST) for leadership syncs and campaign monitoring.



Compensation & Premium Benefits:

Base Salary: $1,200 – $1,450 USD / month – We are looking for elite talent and are prepared to pay top-of-market rates for the right expert.

Uncapped Bonus Structure: Generous performance bonuses and commissions tied directly to the closed deals generated from your infrastructure.

Growth Trajectory: As the first major technical hire in this department, you will have a direct opportunity to grow into a leadership role as the company expands.



HOW TO APPLY:

Please reply with the subject line: [Growth Ops Application - (Your Name)] and include:

Your updated Resume highlighting your technical outbound experience.

A link to your LinkedIn Profile.

A brief breakdown of the most complex cold
 infrastructure you have personally built and managed (number of domains/inboxes) and the specific tactics you used to maintain high deliverability and manage A/B testing at scale.

title: LSA Call Reviewer
description:
ABOUT SHOP MARKETING PROS:

We are a marketing agency based in the United States with a stateside and international team of over 50 professionals. Shop Marketing Pros is a very well-respected and rapidly growing Digital Marketing Company in the Automotive Repair Industry with strong core values and a superb track record of serving its clients better than competitors. Our key services include Website Design, Digital Advertising, Search Engine Optimization, and Social Media Management. 



Our Core Values are of incredible importance to us. We live by our “SHIELD” so please visit 
/core-values/ and familiarize yourself with our Core Values before continuing. Please continue with this job description and application if you feel you align with these values.





JOB DESCRIPTION:

Shop Marketing Pros is seeking a detail-oriented LSA Call Reviewer to join our Digital Ads team. In this role, your primary responsibility will be to listen to and rate phone calls from approximately 69 Google Local Services Ads (LSA) accounts using the Google LSA Dashboard. We utilize tracking numbers connected to GuestX, which automatically apply tags to calls. The hired candidate will review each call and accurately match the corresponding tags within the LSA Dashboard according to our established rating process. This is a highly structured and repetitive role that requires sustained focus, consistency, and attention to detail. Success depends on your ability to remain attentive, apply rating criteria consistently, and maintain accuracy throughout repetitive tasks.



The LSA Call Reviewer will directly support our Digital Ads Team in optimizing client advertising performance and assist our Client Success Team by ensuring accurate reporting. You will follow a standardized call rating scale and established workflow developed through extensive research and optimization. Comprehensive training will be provided, and the selected candidate will be expected to consistently follow the proven process already in place.





REQUIRED SKILLS:

The perfect candidate has/is:

Strong understanding of the English language (listening and comprehension)

Exceptional attention to detail and ability to follow a structured evaluation process

Extremely comfortable working with repetitive tasks

Reliable and able to meet deadlines consistently

Comfortable working independently after initial training

Access to a reliable internet connection and computer

Keen ability to stay alert and attentive to the task at hand

Ability to learn and follow already established processes and systems for call listening





JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Listen to phone calls generated from Local Services Ads (LSAs) in the Google dashboard

Rate each call based on the standardized call rating scale provided

Match tags in the LSA Dashboard

Ensure all calls for the previous month are rated by the 6th of the following month

Collaborate with the Ads Project Manager for training, updates, and ongoing communication

Maintain accuracy and consistency in call ratings to support ad optimization and client reporting





MORE INFO, BENEFITS + PERKS:

1. This is a full-time, permanent, remote position from 8 am to 4 pm Central Time.

2. 13th Month Pay

3. Unlimited PTO (after 3 months of employment)

4. 8 Paid Holiday Leaves

5. Paid time off beginning Christmas Eve until New Year’s Day (so long as we are capable of offering it)

6. An extraordinary team/company culture





INSTRUCTIONS FOR APPLICATION:

1. Use this subject line: “SMP Call Reviewer - [Your Nickname]"

2. In your cover letter, mention which of our core values resonates with you the most.

3. Include a link to your resume.

4. Use at least 7 Apply Points to qualify for this job.

5. Please DO NOT
 me. Let’s keep all communication in the OLJ space.

title: Tiktok Shop Video Editor
description:
I am looking for an experienced Tiktok Shop editor. 



Someone that is familiar with the fast past, constant motion of Tiktok and the need to be skilled in editing for appealing video flows for Tiktok Shop products. 



IF YOU DO NOT HAVE EXPERIENCE IN VIDEO EDITING AT A HIGH LEVEL DON NOT APPLY



This position will require 25-30 edited videos per day. The expectation is that you will be able to follow an inspiration video and use your creativity to ensure the video looks appealing. 



understanding english is a must



You will primarily be editing:



b-roll videos

talking head style

skit style

product review style





I am looking for an experienced editor that can handle the volume. 



Many videos will take about 2 minutes to edit while some b-roll videos will take a bit longer. I have never taken more than 20 minutes to edit 1 video. The expectation is that you can do the same without me having to hand hold you. 



I do not do briefs as the video being recorded is too simple to require a brief. I will on occasion send a video as "inspiration" 



You must know: 



how to create a good flow in a video

how to change scenes a lot but then slow it down as well

how to edit slow and fast dynamic zooms and other effects

be willing to watch a lot of recommended content to get better at the style we are aiming for

have high speed reliable internet

have capcut desktop

no issues with power outages

have google chat

have google drive



be willing to communicate

be willing to do the work



Pay will be every 2 weeks

this is a salary position at $150 usd every 2 weeks

there is also a bonus structure

(this is where most editors make A TON)



in the first 30 days if a video hits 100k view there is a $10usd bonus on that 1 video

if that same video goes to 1 Million views there is an additional $40usd bonus. 



1 video you edit has the potential to make you $50usd extra on top of your salary. 

With 25-30 videos being edited and posted everyday, the potential is very high for additional income. 



i have found that this type of structure really incentives you to do a good job!







In order to apply you will be required to do 2 video re-creates. If you are a good editor this should take 15-20 minutes tops. It took me about 5 minutes to edit each video.  



First-

I will give you the raw footage and my completed video and I want to see if you can recreate it. 



Second-

I will give you only the raw footage and then we will compare your completed video to mine to see how close you came. 







If you would like to apply please
 me and I will send you the recreate tasks

?

Generate qualified sales opportunities by contacting prospective customers, identifying packaging needs, gathering buying intelligence, and scheduling introductory meetings for company leadership.

?

?

You are comfortable speaking with business professionals and decision makers.

?

?

?

?

?
